description: This file manages temporary files, including creation, activation, deactivation, cleanup on exit or signal, and file operations such as open, close, rename, and delete. It maintains a linked list of active temp files and ensures cleanup in various scenarios.

classes.name: struct tempfile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file with fields for filename, file descriptor, FILE pointer, owner PID, associated directory, and list linkage.

methods.name: remove_template_directory
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile, with special handling if called from a signal handler.

methods.name: remove_tempfiles
methods.description: Removes all active tempfiles owned by the current process, optionally called from a signal handler.

methods.name: remove_tempfiles_on_exit
methods.description: Cleanup function registered with atexit to remove tempfiles.

methods.name: remove_tempfiles_on_signal
methods.description: Signal handler to cleanup tempfiles upon receiving a signal.

methods.name: new_tempfile
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile structure.

methods.name: activate_tempfile
methods.description: Adds a tempfile to the global list and sets its owner PID, initializing signal and exit handlers on first call.

methods.name: deactivate_tempfile
methods.description: Removes a tempfile from the list and frees associated resources.

methods.name: create_tempfile_mode
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file at a specified path with given mode, fixing permissions.

methods.name: register_tempfile
methods.description: Registers an existing file as a tempfile.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_sm
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with a filename based on a template and suffix length.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with a filename in TMPDIR or /tmp based on a template.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_dt
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and a tempfile within it based on a directory template.

methods.name: xmks_tempfile_m
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with a filename based on a template, aborting on failure.

methods.name: fdopen_tempfile
methods.description: Associates a FILE pointer with the tempfile's file descriptor.

methods.name: get_tempfile_path
methods.description: Returns the filename of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fp
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer of the tempfile.

methods.name: close_tempfile_gently
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor and FILE pointer, without deleting the file.

methods.name: reopen_tempfile
methods.description: Reopens a closed tempfile for writing.

methods.name: rename_tempfile
methods.description: Renames a tempfile to a new path, closing and deactivating it.

methods.name: delete_tempfile
methods.description: Deletes and deactivates a tempfile, removing its file and directory.
